messages:
maria_pm: Hey team — planning a soft launch for Feature X next quarter. Proposal: traffic fractionation based on per-tenant weights + an opt-out list for top 10% customers. Need guardrails and a quick decision on cadence.

kyle_eng: I like weight + gradual cadence. Suggest 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 4 business days, with a weekend hold between 5% and 20% if we want extra bake time.

anita_sre: Add a circuit-breaker: if p50 latency > 250ms OR error-rate delta > +1.0% vs baseline sustained for 10m, auto rollback. Also require a deploy-bot annotated runbook and smoke-checks for /health and /_canary.

simon_cs: Can we auto-exempt any customers who requested manual hold? I can pull the CRM holdlist and tag them on the flag.

maria_pm: Yes — opt-outs come from CS list. Also want an A/B telemetry arm: 10% sampled golden vs new model to capture quality regressions. Need per-route quality metrics (BLEU/ROUGE-like or custom evals).

kyle_eng: Implementation sketch: feature flag with per-tenant "weight" and explicit overrides. Quick flag JSON draft: ```{
  "flag": "feat_x_soft_launch",
  "variants": ["control","new"],
  "default_weight": 0.005,
  "stages": [
    {"day":1,"target":0.005},
    {"day":2,"target":0.01},
    {"day":3,"target":0.05},
    {"day":5,"target":0.2}
  ]
}```

anita_sre: We should scope the first canary to us-east-1 only and route non-canary traffic elsewhere. Health checks must include synthetic QPS and token-latency checks. Also add a manual operator "stop_all" override that immediately lifts traffic to control.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feat_x flag creation at 2026-07-12T14:00Z. /cc @maria_pm @kyle_eng

simon_cs: :thumbsup: I'll confirm the holdlist by EOD and add customer annotations to the flag metadata.

maria_pm: Decision items before flag creation: 1) approve ramp cadence (kyle's numbers?) 2) confirm rollback thresholds (anita's defaults) 3) CS holdlist delivered by EOD 4) telemetry dashboard and golden-vs-new sampling ready. Anyone object?

kyle_eng: No objections. We'll add metric hooks (p50/p95 latency, error-rate delta, quality signals) and implement an automatic fallback variant that returns the previous model if quality drops.

anita_sre: One more: require an ops checklist entry for the Console to surface "stop_all" and per-tenant override UI, with RBAC so only SRE+Ops can trigger.

maria_pm: Great — I'll update the spec PR with these items and post the runbook. Target: runbook + flag config PR by Friday. Thanks all.
